services.name: Our Current Exhibit
services.desc: NASHVILLE, TN-July 2024-The American Association for State and Local History (AASLH) proudly announces that the Glencoe Historical Society is the recipient of a 2024 Leadership in History Award of Excellence for its current exhibit on Glencoe’s Black Heritage. This award celebrates the extraordinary effort of the all-volunteer Glencoe Historical Society (GHS), which spent five years diligently working to uncover and document the little-known Black history of the small village of Glencoe, Illinois. services.name: Downtown Docent Tours
services.desc: Glencoe’s vibrant business district has different monikers depending on when you moved to the village. Spend a Sunday afternoon with us as we trace the development of the business district, from its 1890s beginnings as the home of blacksmith shops and liveries to 2025’s plethora of restaurants, niche boutiques and interesting governmental buildings. We’ll look at the history of the area, its architecture and reveal why our Village President today refers to this area as Uptown. The 90 minute tour will begin and end at the Glencoe Historical Society, 377 Park Avenue. Bring your curiosity and camera! We’ll look at the business district as you have never seen it before!
